name: queria
description: Explore and query Queria's public Japanese open data (data.queria.io) read-only: zipcode, corporate registry, e-Stat statistics, geospatial, real estate, and more, with cross-dataset joins. Also publish datasets of your own: declare them, push them, and decide what each description should say. Write pages (articles and dashboards) from SQL and charts. Compare places in Japan for a location decision (where to open a shop, where to live) from the data.
